query:
SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.name,
  ac.email AS email_cadastrado,
  u.email AS email_login,
  ac.is_active,
  BINARY ac.email = u.email AS case_match
FROM allowed_clients ac
JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(ac.email)
WHERE BINARY ac.email != u.email
ORDER BY ac.name;
